Hi Steam Support Team,
I am writing to request/appeal eligibility for our game, Eggo (AppID: 3700760), to participate in the upcoming Companion Falls for You: Desktop Companion Games, Celebrated This Autumn.
We noticed the game hasn't been automatically included, but it was designed from the ground up as a pure desktop companion experience. It perfectly aligns with the fest's specific criteria:

Unobtrusive Desktop Presence: The game does not interfere with the user's daily tasks. It is designed to be played in a windowed mode, occupying only a small portion of the screen (such as the bottom or side) while the player works, studies, or browses the web on their computer.

Passive Progression: This is absolutely not a "focus-intensive" game. The core loop progresses automatically even when the user is not actively interacting with it. For example, your Eggo grows, explores different planets for treasures, and builds relationships with friends' Eggos over time—all while you're away from the keyboard.

Casual & Idle Nature: The game fundamentally belongs to the relaxing/idle genre. It provides a comforting, low-pressure companion experience rather than demanding the player's direct attention. Whether it's dressing up your Eggo, watching it interact with friends' pets, or even discovering a hybrid baby egg, every moment feels light, joyful, and effortlessly engaging.

We believe Eggo is exactly the type of experience players will be looking for during this event. Could you please review our game and grant us registration eligibility?
Thank you for your time and help!
Best regards,
Dev team
